title: fix(console): re-ticking a dashboard card's Apply restores the shipped filter binding
body:
repo:objectstack#7 · os-alice · session_011y7As5bdhV5T4N9vpjmZzH

Fixes #37031

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none — no authoring surface changes; a console panel restores a value the package already ships

## 维护者速读

- 管理员在仪表盘页内编辑（以及 Studio 的仪表盘编辑器）里，把某张卡片「跟着顶部筛选」的勾选取消再重新勾上并保存后，这张卡片会恢复应用原本设定的筛选字段，不再卡在「不跟随」的状态；其他卡片和保存方式不变。
- 属于仪表盘页内编辑这条线，替调整已安装应用仪表盘的管理员解决「取消了就再也改不回来」的问题。
- 若判断错了，最坏情况是重新勾选后卡片按筛选自己的字段过滤（即本次修改前的行为）；改动只在界面一侧，直接撤回本次合并即可恢复原状。
- 无

## What changes

- `DashboardWidgetInspector` (the card panel Studio and the in-page edit state share): re-ticking **Apply** on a filter row now writes the binding the dashboard **as its package ships it** gives that card, when that binding re-targets the filter to a field (a string). Where the shipped card opts out too (`false`), binds nothing, or is not in the shipped document, the entry is dropped as before. Unticking still writes `false`. A new exported helper `shippedFilterBinding` reads it.
- `MetadataInspectorProps` gains an optional `shipped` prop: the item as its package ships it (the layered read's `code`). It is a React prop of an internal module of `@object-ui/app-shell` (not in its `exports`), not metadata.
- `openDashboardForEdit` returns `shipped` from the same layered read it opens the document from (the pair's read, or the base's when the pair does not hold the item yet); the edit state keeps it and `DashboardEditPanel` hands it to the card panel. No extra request.
- Studio's editor (`ResourceEditPage`) hands its scoped inspector `shipped` from the layered read it already keeps. Same defect class through the same panel, one line, pinned in that page's existing inspector harness.

Read first, by risk:

1. `DashboardWidgetInspector.tsx`, the Apply checkbox's `onCommit` and `shippedFilterBinding`: what a re-tick writes.
2. `DashboardInPageEditor.tsx`, `openDashboardForEdit`: which layered read `shipped` comes from.
3. `ResourceEditPage.tsx`, `shippedLayerOf` and the `InspectorComponent` props.

## Why

Measured, not the card's mechanism. The overlay is not merged key by key: a save into `com.example.showcase.custom` stores the whole dashboard document (ADR-0146, whole-document override). On `main` re-ticking deleted `filterBindings.dateRange`, which binds the card to the filter's own field, `issued_on`. `kpi_new_accounts` reads the account dataset, which has no `issued_on`, so the PUT staged the draft (200) and the **publish was refused** (422 `INVALID_METADATA`, rule `dashboard-filter-field-unknown`: "inherits dashboard filter `dateRange(issued_on)`, but object `showcase_account` ... has no field `issued_on`"). The editor then discards its draft, so the served dashboard keeps `dateRange: false`. The value to restore is the package's own re-target (`signed_on`), which only the shipped layer carries once the overlay holds `false`. The server's merge contract is unchanged.

## Tests

<details><summary>New and updated pins (app-shell, run from ui/ root)</summary>

`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2` over the four files below at `4e94d7d45cb`: Test Files 4 passed (4), Tests 67 passed (67); lock VERDICT command-exit 0.

- `DashboardWidgetInspector.test.tsx`, new describe "re-ticking Apply restores the shipped binding": unticking writes `{ dateRange: false, region: 'sales_region' }`; re-ticking an opt-out writes `{ dateRange: 'signed_on', region: 'sales_region' }`; control: a shipped `false`, no shipped binding, or a shipped card with another id drops the entry (`{ region: 'sales_region' }`). The existing "re-ticking removes the entry" case (no `shipped`) stays as a second control.
- `DashboardInPageEditor.test.ts`: `openDashboardForEdit` returns `shipped` (the code layer) for a writable package, for a base opened before the pair holds the item, for a pair holding a customization (one layered read, at the pair), and `null` when nothing ships.
- `DashboardView.inPageEdit-36372.test.tsx`: through the real `DashboardView`, the card panel is handed the code layer of an installed app's customized dashboard.
- `ResourceEditPage.inspectorReadOnlyReason-29079.test.tsx`: the page hands a registered scoped inspector the layered read's `code`, and `null` when nothing ships.

</details>

<details><summary>Ablation at head 4e94d7d45cb (fix committed first; mutation landed on disk, then restored)</summary>

`node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` replaced `setBinding(apply ? shippedFilterBinding(shipped, widget.id, def.name) : false)` with `setBinding(apply ? undefined : false)` (the `main` behaviour). Anchor 1 to 0, blob `574a32e50efa` to `812b69365391`. Predicted: only the re-tick case goes red; the untick case and the controls stay green. Observed: 1 failed, 21 passed, the failure being "re-ticking an opt-out restores the field the shipped dashboard binds". Restore: blob equals HEAD `574a32e50efa`, `git diff HEAD` empty. No build step: the suite imports the inspector from source.

</details>

<details><summary>Type check and lint</summary>

- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell run type-check` (both programs, `tsconfig.json` and `tsconfig.test.json`) at `4e94d7d45cb`, after building the `@object-ui/app-shell^...` closure: lock VERDICT command-exit 0.
- `eslint --no-inline-config` over the eight changed TS/TSX files: 3 errors, all in `ResourceEditPage.tsx` and all `react-hooks/static-components` on lines that carry an inline disable on `main`; the same command over `origin/main`'s copy of that file reports the same 3 errors. The diff adds none. The repo-wide run is CI's.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- The **Reset** link under a re-targeted field still clears the entry to the filter's own field, as on `main`; on `kpi_new_accounts` that is a field the dataset lacks, and the publish refuses it with the rule above, saying what to do. Whether Reset should mean "the shipped binding" is a product question, not this card's.
- A re-target the author wrote in the overlay (not shipped), then unticked and re-ticked, comes back as the shipped binding (or the default), not as the overlay's field: the panel keeps no memory of an earlier value.
- The card says the re-check publish answered 200; replaying the editor's PUT body over REST on a fresh showcase it answered 422 as above (the PUT itself answered 200).

## Verification

Two-minute check: `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/inspectors/DashboardWidgetInspector.test.tsx` and expect 22 passed. In the app: `OS_PORT=3000 pnpm dev`, open the Revenue Pulse dashboard, Edit, select "Accounts Signed", untick Date's Apply, Save; Edit again, tick it, Save. Expect a "Dashboard saved" toast, and the Date row showing "Customer Since" after a reload.

<details><summary>Browser check on showcase at head 4e94d7d45cb (console built from that head)</summary>

Fresh showcase (`objectstack dev --ui --seed-admin`, own port, own DB), Chromium driven by Playwright, as `admin@objectos.ai`, on `/_console/apps/com.example.showcase/dashboard/showcase_revenue_pulse`:

1. GET before: `kpi_new_accounts.filterBindings` = `{"dateRange":"signed_on","region":"sales_region"}`.
2. Edit, select the card, Date's Apply checked at open; untick, Save. PUT `?mode=draft&package=com.example.showcase.custom` 200 with body `filterBindings` `{"dateRange":false,"region":"sales_region"}`; publish 200; toast "Dashboard saved". GET after: `{"dateRange":false,"region":"sales_region"}`.
3. Edit again, Apply unchecked at open; tick, Save. PUT 200 with body `filterBindings` `{"dateRange":"signed_on","region":"sales_region"}`; publish 200 (seq 4); toast "Dashboard saved". GET after: `{"dateRange":"signed_on","region":"sales_region"}`.
4. Reload: GET `{"dateRange":"signed_on","region":"sales_region"}`; reopened edit state shows Date's Apply checked with the field "Customer Since" (the `signed_on` label). Discarded.

Control (before the fix: REST replay of `main`'s re-tick body; the server is unchanged by this diff): after the untick, a PUT with `filterBindings` `{"region":"sales_region"}` answered 200 and its publish 422 `dashboard-filter-field-unknown`; GET stayed `{"dateRange":false,...}`.

</details>

Local gates at `4e94d7d45cb`: `dispatch-gates --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derives 39 families for this diff; all 39 exited 0 (`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/`: 172 files passed, 2 skipped). `dispatch-gates --ran` with exit codes: 39 derived, 39 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a derived zero). `pnpm --dir ui check:new-line-citations`: 0 new citations.
